fib: ______ is a critical resource needed for plant growth.
Water in the soil
Water in the soil is a critical resource needed for plant growth.
______ refers to all methods used to reduce or prevent the detrimental affects of flood waters.
Flood control
Flood Control Flood control refers to all methods used to reduce or prevent the detrimental affects of flood waters.
______ is the restocking of existing forests and woodlands which have been depleted.
Reforestation
Reforestation is the restocking of existing forests and woodlands which have been depleted.
______ is the total quantity of sediment transported from a watershed (drainage basin) at a given location in a given period of time.
Sediment yield
Sediment yield is the total quantity of sediment transported from a watershed (drainage basin) at a given location in a given period of time.
______ is a practice or device designed to keep eroded soil on a construction site or other places, so that it does not wash off and cause water pollution to a nearby stream, river, lake, or bay.
Sediment control

Sediment control is a practice or device designed to keep eroded soil on a construction site or other places, so that it does not wash off and cause water pollution to a nearby stream, river, lake, or bay.
______ is the standard in the United States (Viessman and Lewis, 2003).
pan
Weather Bureau Class A pan is the standard in the United States (Viessman and Lewis, 2003).
______ is used in very many processes.
Rain that falls on land
Rain that falls on land is used in very many processes.
______ is the amount of water that is actually removed.
Actual evapotranspiration (AE)
Actual evapotranspiration
AE
Actual evapotranspiration (AE) is the amount of water that is actually removed.
______ is derived from atmospheric water, its form and quantity thus being influenced by the action of other climatic factors such as wind, temperature, and atmospheric pressure.
Precipitation
Precipitation is derived from atmospheric water, its form and quantity thus being influenced by the action of other climatic factors such as wind, temperature, and atmospheric pressure.
______ is a related process involving water loss from plants.
Transpiration
Transpiration is a related process involving water loss from plants.
______ are the source of precipitation; however, evaporation and condensation processes are the driving forces.
Clouds
Clouds are the source of precipitation; however, evaporation and condensation processes are the driving forces.
______ is a "savings account" of water that can receive deposits and allow withdrawals as conditions change in the water balance.
Soil moisture storage
Soil moisture storage is a "savings account" of water that can receive deposits and allow withdrawals as conditions change in the water balance.
______ is the most abundant compound in the biosphere.
Water
Water is the most abundant compound in the biosphere.

______ is the relevance of hydrology in predicting geomorphological changes, such as erosion or sedimentation, and assessing the impacts of natural and anthropogenic environmental change on water resources.
Worthy of note

Worthy of note is the relevance of hydrology in predicting geomorphological changes, such as erosion or sedimentation, and assessing the impacts of natural and anthropogenic environmental change on water resources.
______ is a measure of the ability of the atmosphere to remove water from the surface, assuming no limitation of water supply.
Potential evapotranspiration (PE)
Potential evapotranspiration
PE
Potential evapotranspiration (PE) is a measure of the ability of the atmosphere to remove water from the surface, assuming no limitation of water supply.
